name: Large Professor
hook: A producer who learned the SP-1200 from Paul C, taught Q-Tip, discovered Nas, and turns up in the credits all over early-90s New York.
blurb: William Mitchell, known as Large Professor, is a producers' producer: the teacher in several of the lineages on this map. He learned to use the SP-1200 from Paul C (Paul McKasty), an engineer and producer who worked on records for Ultramagnetic MCs and others before he was killed in 1989, and who is not on the map yet. With his group Main Source he made the album Breaking Atoms in 1991, and on one song he gave a verse to a seventeen-year-old called Nas. He helped Q-Tip of A Tribe Called Quest learn the SP-1200 and another sampler, the Akai S950, and later produced three songs on Nas's first album.
